firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently disembarked from a ship becomes captain of the first voyage.
clarifications: The first captain places their figure at the front of the ship; the other players join as sailors.
For each later voyage, the player to the left of the current captain becomes the new captain.
During a voyage, sailors make their decisions in any order after the captain sets the course and before the next tile is revealed.
A captain left alone on the ship continues that voyage; this is not a separate solo mode. The rules list 2–5 players.
Final-score ties compare rubies, then treasure chests, then barrels. These comparisons do not choose the first captain.
